title: Marchantia Agrobacterium Transformation of Sporelings in Multi-Well Plates
author: Linda Silvestri
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.92ah8ae

steps.title: Sterilize and Plate Spores
steps.instruction: Prepare and plate Marchantia spores on growth media.

substeps.instruction: Transfer sporangia to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube (use 2 sporangia per planned transformation; e.g., 12 sporangia for 6 transformations).
Crush sporangia with metal tweezers, add 0.5 mL of Milton solution per tube, and vortex to create a fine pulp.
Place a 40μM cell strainer on a 50 mL Falcon tube and pour the crushed sporangia onto the filter.
Rinse the Eppendorf tube with 1 mL of fresh Milton solution and pour onto the filter.
Wash the filter with 2.5 mL of fresh Milton solution.
Divide the filtrate (approx. 4 mL total) into four 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and let stand for 20-30 min total sterilization time (counting from the start of the process).
Centrifuge tubes at 16,000g for 2 min in a tabletop centrifuge.
Discard supernatant and pool spores in a single tube; resuspend pellets in 25 μL per planned transformation.
Plate spores on 0.5 x Gamborg plates using 50 μL per plate (one plate per 2 transformations).
Seal plates with micropore tape and grow for 5 days at 21°C under continuous light.

steps.title: Transform Agrobacterium
steps.instruction: Introduce the plasmid of interest into Agrobacterium cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 ng of plasmid to 50 μL of thawed electro-competent Agrobacterium cells on ice.
Transfer the mixture to a chilled 2 mm gap electroporation cuvette.
Electroporate with a 2.5 kV pulse.
Recover cells by adding 0.5 mL of LB or SOC to the cuvette and incubating for 1-2h at 28°C and 150 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare Agrobacterium Culture
steps.instruction: Select and grow the transformed Agrobacterium.

substeps.instruction: Plate 50 μL of recovered cells on LB plates with appropriate selection antibiotics and incubate for 2-3 days at 30°C.
Inoculate a single transformed colony into 5 mL LB media plus antibiotics.
Incubate at 28°C with shaking at 150 rpm for 2 days.

steps.title: Prepare Agrobacterium for Transformation
steps.instruction: Process the Agrobacterium culture for sporeling infection.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 5 mL culture for 10 minutes at 3000g.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 5 mL of 0.5x Gamborg B5 plus supplements.
Add acetosyringone to a final concentration of 100 μM.
Incubate for 6h at 28°C and 150 rpm.

steps.title: Perform Agro-mediated Sporeling Transformation
steps.instruction: Infect 5-day-old sporelings with Agrobacterium in multi-well plates.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 50 mL Falcon tube containing 4 mL (per transformation) of 0.5 x Gamborg B5 plus supplements media with 100 μM acetosyringone.
Using a sterile scalpel, transfer 5-day-old Marchantia sporelings from plates to the 50 mL Falcon tube and mix well.
Using a serological pipette, add 4 mL of the sporeling solution into each well of a 6-well plate.
Add 100 μL of the prepared Agrobacterium culture to each well.
Seal the plate with micropore tape and place on a shaker at 120 rpm for 2 days at 21°C under continuous light.

steps.title: Wash and Plate Transformants
steps.instruction: Remove Agrobacterium and plate sporelings for selection.

substeps.instruction: Transfer sporelings from the well to a 70 μm cell strainer placed in a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Wash sporelings by pouring 50 mL of sterile water supplemented with 100 μg/ml cefotaxime through the strainer.
Plate sporelings on 0.5 x Gamborg B5 plus vitamins 1.2% agar plates containing 100 μg/ml cefotaxime and selective antibiotics.
Repeat the transfer, wash, and plating process for all wells.
After 5-7 days, screen plates for visible transformants and fluorescence.
